name: corridor
short: Shared reply style and permission tiers for office-cogs.
description: Owns one guild-wide store for reply formatting (text/embed, icon) and moderator/privileged role tiers, exposed to other cogs via required_cogs so they don't each reinvent it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
author: Tin Nguyen
